general.keepScreenOn: Keep the screen on while playing
general.tvModeAuto: Auto (on when a TV is detected)
general.tvFocusOutlineSubtitle: For performance: focus does not enlarge, for low-end TV boxes
general.autoRefreshFollows: Refresh the live status of follows on a timer
general.refreshOnResume: Refresh follows when returning to the app
general.refreshCoversSubtitle: Covers of live cards are downloaded again at the interval, so they stay current

appearance.denseSubtitle: Streamer name and title on one line
appearance.accentColorSubtitle: The theme colour follows the Windows accent colour
appearance.wallpaperColorSubtitle: Android 12 and later: the theme colour comes from the wallpaper
appearance.compactCardsPhone: Compact cards in Discover and Search (phone)
appearance.compactCardsDesktop: Compact cards in Discover and Search (desktop)
appearance.fontsSubtitle: Download open-source fonts for the interface or danmaku

playback.autoLower: Lower the quality on an unstable network
playback.autoLowerSubtitle: Three stalls within a minute drop one step; no automatic change after you pick a quality yourself
playback.autoFullscreen: Full screen when a room opens
playback.swipeRooms: Swipe up and down to switch rooms in portrait full screen
playback.swipeRoomsSubtitle: Swipe up for the next room and down for the previous one; brightness and volume no longer follow vertical swipes in portrait full screen
playback.portraitAdaptationSubtitle: Detect portrait streams and use portrait full screen with a draggable info panel on phones
playback.orientationSource: Follow the picture (portrait streams stay portrait)
playback.rememberOrientationSubtitle: A room's Treat as portrait / landscape choice still applies next time
playback.backgroundSubtitle: Keep playing the sound after leaving the app
playback.sleepModeSubtitle: Rooms open with sound only and start the sleep timer; restoring the picture cancels that timer

accounts.platformsSubtitle: Which platforms show, their order and Discover's default platform
accounts.audienceSubtitle: Whether cards show heat or viewers, and what each platform's figures mean
accounts.accountsSubtitle: Sign in to or out of each platform

tvDarkOnlySubtitle: The pure black switch still applies

output.defaultVolumeDesktop: Default volume (rooms without a saved volume)
output.hardwareDecodingSubtitle: Turn it off if the picture looks wrong
output.compatibilitySubtitle: Turn on if some devices show black or garbled video or freeze
output.lowLatencySubtitle: Less buffering and delay; stalls more on a poor network

record.monitoringSubtitle: Start recording when the streamer goes live
record.backoffSubtitle: Each failed retry or live check doubles the wait, up to the longest interval
record.readTimeout: Read timeout (how long without data counts as disconnected)
record.splitDuration: Split by duration (minutes, 0 for no split)
record.saveDanmakuSubtitle: An XML file named like the video
record.keepFlv: Keep the original FLV after converting
record.pinyinFoldersSubtitle: Use streamer names in pinyin for folders, for devices that cannot show Chinese
record.limitSizeSubtitle: Above the limit, the oldest recordings are deleted first; recordings in progress are kept

audience.heatFirstSubtitle: Shows each platform's public heat or total views, which are not concurrent viewers
audience.onlineFirstSubtitle: Shows concurrent viewers when the platform gives them, otherwise heat or total views

network.useProxySubtitle: An HTTP proxy, such as Clash on port 7897; when on, the system proxy is not used
network.proxyAll: Every platform uses the proxy now. Once you select platforms below, only those use it.
network.proxySelected: Only the selected platforms use the proxy.
network.systemProxyManual: Not used while the manual proxy is on
network.systemProxyNone: The system has no proxy; connecting directly

platformsHint: Tick the platforms to show in Discover, Search and Platform accounts, and drag to reorder; tap the star to make one Discover's default.
